verdict.rationale: Inngest documents capturing execution data for every function run, including traces, event logs, and per-step timing with no instrumentation (inngest-docs-20). Steps retry independently (inngest-docs-15), and failed runs can be located and their traces pulled to find the broken step (inngest-docs-37, inngest-docs-8), so a per-run, per-step trace view clearly exists. However, the evidence does not show per-step inputs and outputs or a team dashboard with search and filtering; the documented failure-finding flow is CLI-based. Missing for 10: explicit per-step input/output display, documented dashboard search/filter over runs, independent hands-on corroboration of the run timeline UI.
